tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Create a human approval request for an irreversible action. Returns approve_url (pass it to the responsible human through your own channel) and approval_id. Optional wait_seconds keeps the call open (progress notifications every 10 s when the client sends a progressToken) until the human decides. 3

tools.name: get_approval
tools.description: Free. Status of an approval request (pending | approved | denied | expired). When decided, includes the Ed25519-signed receipt (compact JWS). Optional wait_seconds long-polls until a decision.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Free. Verify an Approval Relay decision receipt (compact JWS) against the current public key and return its decoded payload.
